name: Spiral Destiny
source:
AU Bangkok, sometime in the future.
Ratana and her friends are shopping at a shopping complex when an earthquake and tsunami hits.
The building is flooding and falling apart. Ratana and friends are trapped inside the building waiting for rescue, but with such a large scaled tsunami, they aren't the only ones needing help...

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=45&t=14684]LemmaSoft Forum[/url]]
